findings.statement: [CONFIRMED_CODE_DEFECT] NumPy Rodas5P can fabricate a successful terminal event after refinement failure: if every refinement substep fails, _refine_event reruns the full substep, discards its ok flag, and returns that state; the adapter publishes t_events/success and canonical full_coupled trusts the event. A bounded monkeypatch reproduction produced an event residual of 123. The same layer also misses initial/exact-zero directionless events, accepts NaN event functions as interval success, truncates fractional direction (0.5 to 0), ignores event.terminal, accepts only one event callable, and infers status from message text. Live comparison showed SciPy stopping at t=0 while the adapter completed, and a downward crossing incorrectly triggered for direction=0.5.
assumptions_used: Synthetic probes establish API behavior, not frequency on a physical trajectory.
counterevidence_refs: Current full-coupled events use terminal=True and direction=-1; the adapter is opt-in and default BDF is unaffected.
reproduction: Use the recorded initial-zero, NaN-event, fractional-direction and forced-refinement-failure probes.
unresolved: Physical-endpoint incidence is unmeasured.

Executed CPU probes returned success/no-event for initial-zero and NaN events, success for rtol=0 and atol<0, and success with nonfinite final state for zero-span NaN/Inf input. This threatens parity/AD oracle validity, not production promotion.

counterevidence_refs: Ordinary downward event, max-step, analytic, NumPy-twin and linear-action tests passed.

The max_attempts=1 test exercises an accepted path and does not falsify this construction.

No bad-solver test exists. solve_ode_jax, make_diffrax_solver and extract_h_tape_from_adaptive_solve have no direct in-repository caller/test evidence, although external consumers may exist. This is wrapper consistency/debt, not a Diffrax numerical failure.
assumptions_used: Plain and diagnostic forms should reject the same bad solver consistently.
counterevidence_refs: All 18 executed Diffrax/adjoint happy-path and parity tests passed.
reproduction: Compare dictionary selection in plain and diagnostic wrappers; search direct callers.
unresolved: External consumers are outside the static completeness ceiling.

findings.statement: [PROVENANCE_AND_DOCUMENTATION_DEBT] Rust OdeConfig is mutable and neither serialized nor embedded/digested in OdeResult, so a result alone cannot prove tolerances, step bounds or budget; sealed source/binary evidence supplies indirect provenance. The isotropic_boltzmann module header is stale, saying only identical same-flavour scattering exists while the authoritative current catalogue has all nine rows. Neither issue is a numerical failure and anti-drift policy forbids solving them with new standalone manifest/gate plumbing.
assumptions_used: Comparison artifacts require configuration identity.
The generated status/context supersedes stale module prose.
counterevidence_refs: Frozen test source plus source/binary hashes can bind controls indirectly; runtime catalogue tests are authoritative.
reproduction: Inspect OdeConfig/OdeResult derives and compare module prose to the generated catalogue status.
